verdict.rationale: Slate's orchestration feature lets users spin up multiple agents in parallel (shown as a grid of subagent cards) and double-click into any card to review that agent's full session, which supports running parallel tasks and inspecting individual results. However, there's no documented workflow for running multiple *attempts* of the same task and explicitly comparing/choosing among them — the docs describe parallelizing distinct tasks, not attempt comparison/selection. Missing for 10: explicit multi-attempt-of-same-task support, a comparison/diff UI across attempts, and independent hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
